data.oracle_gate: 20 fixed paired ID/OOD resets; each split requires at least 19 strict successes
data.norm: computed only from the 128 ID demonstrations and frozen before all training and evaluation

training.id_probe_gate: at least 17 strict successes for checkpoint candidate; independent formal ID gate at least 80/100
training.optimizer: fresh optimizer from immutable X-VLA-Pt foundation

detectors.threshold_calibration: independent successful ID policy rollouts only; freeze before test
methods: FIDeL-AD official ResNet18/euclidean without semantic VLM filter

dagger.gated_stream: frozen mixed ID/OOD seed stream, raw attempts strictly alternating
dagger.gated_target: 100 successful trajectories with nonempty expert suffix per method
dagger.offline_target: complete OOD oracle demonstrations under the matched expert-action budget
dagger.training_balance: original ID data and each method's new expert source sampled 1:1
dagger.training_origin: each method independently starts from the same immutable accepted ID checkpoint

required_assets: persistent output disk with checkpoint/video headroom
